mac.subtitle: Encrypt and share. Pay once.
mac.promotionalText: No subscription. No account. No servers. Encrypt files, folders and text on your computer and share them safely with the people you trust. One price, paid once.
mac.opening: Keep private files private. Doughnut Forge locks your files, folders and text on your computer and lets you share them with the people you trust. However you send them, only they can open them.
mac.noSubscription: No subscription, no account, no servers and no tracking. Doughnut Forge works entirely on your computer, even without an internet connection. Your keys and contacts stay with you, under your control. You pay once, and the app is yours.
mac.closing: Privacy should not be a monthly bill.

features.title: Encrypt files and folders
features.text: Lock a single file or a whole folder in a few clicks, ready to keep safe or to share.

features.title: Encrypt text
features.text: Encrypt a private message for your contacts and share it however you like.

features.title: Your identity, your computer
features.text: Create your identity in the app. Your contact card is safe to share with anyone. It lets people send you private files.

features.title: Share with people you trust
features.text: Encrypt files for any of your contacts. They open them with their own identity. No one else can.

features.title: Built for the long term
features.text: Uses post-quantum encryption, so what you protect today stays protected as computers become more powerful.

features.title: In your language
features.text: Use the app in English, Spanish, Japanese, Ukrainian and many other languages.

features.title: Encrypt files, photos and videos
features.text: Choose a file from Files or a photo or video from your library, or send one from another app. Encrypt it in a few taps, ready to keep or share.

features.title: Open what is sent to you
features.text: Decrypt a file from a contact and save it to Files. Photos and videos can go straight back to your photo library.

features.title: Face ID and Touch ID
features.text: Unlock the app with a glance or a touch if you like. Your password always works too.
